chorus1:
[Chorus, continued]
(Me-kut-te! Me-kut-te!)
To be continued! (Sorekara?) Turn the page, I want to see!
(So-re-ka-ra?! So-re-ka-ra?!)
Sideways, sideways! That's the way a crab walks free!
Snip-snip! Ikuzo!
To be continued (tsuzuku!), and then, and then, and then!

(Me-kut-te! Me-kut-te!)

final_clawd:
[Final Chorus - key change]
To be continued! (Tsuzuku!)
To be continued! (Tsuzuku!)
Don't you dare close the book on me!
I'm made of "why?"!
final_fable:
[Final Chorus - second singer]
And I'm made of "and then."
Sideways, sideways. That's the way we go.
I've read how it ends. I'd still like to see.
To be continued (tsuzuku!), and then, and then, and then—
fable_direction: low contralto, dry, close-mic, straight tone, no vibrato, straight eighths on the pop groove, a sixth to an octave under the lead, every phrase falling to the tonic with its last word half-spoken on the downbeat
